sn1.73:1.1: Kiṃsūdha vittaṃ purisassa seṭṭhaṃ || kiṃsu suciṇṇo sukham āvahāti || kiṃsu have sādutaraṃ rasānaṃ || kathaṃ jīviṃ jūvitam āhu seṭṭhan ti || ||
